legend: Clinical presentation of lymphomatoid granulomatosis, grade 3, with large ulcerating plaques on the back of a 57-year-old female patient, who presented with extensive skin lesions and a cerebellar involvement.

legend: A 56-year-old woman presenting with clusters of erythematous papules on the trunk. A lymphocytic infiltrate is seen in the dermis, with a perivascular pattern.
source: Prof. Dr. Ioannis Anagnostopoulos Institut für Pathologie Universität Würzburg Würzburg Germany

legend: A 56-year-old woman presenting with clusters of erythematous papules on the trunk. Medium-sized to large hyperchromatic atypical lymphoid cells are arranged in a perivascular pattern.
